scripts.lint: cd backend && go test ./... && go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.14.0 run --path-mode=abs
scripts.comment:test: node --test scripts/comment-policy/check.test.mjs && cd backend && go test ./cmd/commentpolicy
scripts.cloud:check: npm --prefix packages/cloud-client run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/cloud-client/src/schema.ts && npm --prefix packages/cloud-client run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/cloud-client test && npm --prefix packages/cloud-client run build
scripts.product-ui:check: npm --prefix packages/product-ui run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/product-ui test && npm --prefix packages/product-ui run build
scripts.hub-bff:check: npm --prefix packages/hub-bff run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/hub-bff test
scripts.shared:check: npm run cloud:check && npm run product-ui:check
scripts.sqlc: cd backend && go run github.com/sqlc-dev/sqlc/cmd/sqlc@v1.31.1 generate
scripts.api: npm run api:spec && npm run api:ts
